notes.title: PATCH 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello, Friends! 

The recent premiere was truly a huge event, wasn't it? You gave us a lot of support, shared multiple comments, gifted us with invaluable feedback, and what's most important, you fell in love with Louise and Mitch!

[h2]We are actively listening to our community and fixing reported bugs and problems - here comes the first [b]Patch 1.0.1[/b]! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063009/0b81eccba29d76f8ab5773c7a5f80d322db2d929.png[/img]

Check out what's changed and tell us how it works for you!

[h3]PATCH NOTES: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the graphical settings: High, Medium, Low,
[*] Added V-Sync option,
[*] Fixed Achievements: "Fast. Not Too Furious", "Student Becomes the Master", "I Have Seen Everything".
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
It's worth mentioning that we are simultaneously releasing this Patch on Steam and Nintendo Switch + soon on all our available platforms.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1684400/Best_Month_Ever/

[h3]Remember to join our other social media and let us know what you think about Best Month Ever![/h3]

TWITTER: https://twitter.com/best_month_ever
FACEBOOK: https://facebook.com/bestmonthevergame
DISCORD: https://discord.gg/meEr6Beew2
